what: Decorative figures like birds and butterflies, once they catch the bottom edge of the screen: they sit transparent 150% of their width to the left and 100px above, then fly in over 1s after a .2s delay (the top offset settles first in .6s, making a slanting path), and after landing the body bobs down by 10% of its height every 3s. look: drop does not fly — it settles from 10% above in .7s and fades in over 1s

options.[data-fx-part=body]: Body to float (child) — if none, it only flies in
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom (original: when the window bottom edge passes the element top edge)
options.--fx-from: Initial offset (css), default -150% (left) · look: drop is -10% (top)
options.--fx-drop: Initial floating height — bottom margin (css), default 100px
options.look: If drop, it only settles down from above

from.where: index.html .cm-bird (original .bird-feature·.bird-partner — transform translateX(-150%) · margin-bottom 100px · opacity 0 → 1s/.6s/1s, delay .2s · .bird_inner fuwafuwa 3s infinite 0→10%→0) · look: drop is .topAcs_bird (translateY(-10%) .7s · opacity 1s)

note: It floats in the bottom margin and then drops down, so attach it to an absolute element positioned with bottom — if attached to an in-flow element, the content below gets pushed along while it settles. The new graphic is a freshly drawn SVG, not the original’s
